_note: The Arduino Foundations bench: one 400-hole breadboard (A), and the Arduino Uno on the table to its left. The Uno does not go in the breadboard: wires go from its header pins to the breadboard holes. mount x and z: the place of the Uno corner at the power header and the USB end. The Uno is turned so that its long side goes along the breadboard columns, and its digital header (D0 to D13) is near the breadboard. open_rails: bbA.+ and bbA.- are the rails on the left, near the Uno. view: the point that the camera looks at, and the size of the bench that it shows, in hole pitches.
